sloka: तत्र ते वचनं शूरः करिष्यति सदा खरः ।रक्षसां कामरूपाणां प्रभुरेष भविष्यति ।। ७.२४.३९ ॥
transliteration: tatra te vacanaṁ śūraḥ kariṣyati sadā kharaḥ ।rakṣasāṁ kāmarūpāṇāṁ prabhureṣa bhaviṣyati ।। 7.24.39 ॥

translations.english: There, the brave Khara will always execute your commands, and he will be the lord of the Rakshasas who can change their form at will.
